description: This file defines the class 'tlRight', which represents a 'right' in the TestLink project. It includes methods for initializing, reading from the database, copying, and string representation of rights objects, as well as static methods for retrieving rights by ID and fetching all rights.

classes.name: tlRight
classes.description: Represents a user right in TestLink, capable of database serialization and deserialization, copying, and static retrieval by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the right object and activates caching.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets the object's properties to a clean state, optionally by ID.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the right as its string representation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the right object with a specific database ID and name.

methods.name: copyFromCache
methods.description: Copies properties from another tlRight object.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads the right object data from the database.

methods.name: readFromDBRow
methods.description: Initializes the object from a database row array.

methods.name: getReadFromDBQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to select rights from the database based on IDs.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a right by its database ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Static method to retrieve multiple rights by their database IDs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all rights from the database, with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Placeholder for writing the object to the database; currently not implemented.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting the object from the database; currently not implemented.
